title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-17
lineage: SBD> PCM> C> DAT> ZA2 downsampling> CDR

ai_review.summary: Clear soundboard recording with solid separation, highlighted by a monster Baby Blue and tight Lost Sailor/​Saint of Circumstance combo; overall an above‑average 1982 performance.
ai_review.review: The set captures a well‑balanced soundboard mix that stays clear throughout, with only minor crackles on Shakedown Street. Musically the show is buoyant – Jerry’s guitar smokes, Brent shines on keyboards, and the encore Baby Blue is repeatedly called one of the best versions. Energy runs high despite the first nine songs being omitted.

ai_rating.rationale: Four out of five reviewers gave 4‑5 stars praising both performance and sound quality; only one mixed review lowers the average slightly.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, well‑separated mix with no muddiness; drums and cymbals are well mic'd. Minor crackles/pops noted on Shakedown Street but attributed to guitar overdrive rather than recording flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First nine tracks missing but the remaining material flows strongly, ending with a memorable Baby Blue encore.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Guitar tone described as ‘smokin’; vocal phrasing on Baby Blue praised early in the set but later noted as deteriorating due to heavy smoking.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass is solid and fully engaged during jams, providing a strong foundation throughout.
band_member_comments.Bob: Loose, energetic rhythm work; noted for letting it loose during the Lost Sailor/​Saint of Circumstance segment.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent's keyboard playing shines, leading the Spanish‑style jam and adding bright texture to the mix.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums and cymbal crashes are well mic'd and clear in the recording.
